messages.subject: LPA
parts: Is there a way to fit an LPA with distal outcomes with lavaan or a package from the lavaan family?

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: LPA
parts:
with lavaan no. But I am working with the developer of the tidySEM package. This one has functions to write lavaan syntax for mixture models, like LPA
You can write the suntax in lavaan syntax, and the mixture model is run in OpenMx

We will write a more detail vignette tutorial for it later

messages.subject: Re: LPA
parts:
In tidySEM you can do a variety of mixture models, see our paper about it here  https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/10705511.2023.2250920

Also, I have some tutorials on how to some mixture models in tidySEM and depmixS4 here  https://github.com/maugavilla/well_hello_stats?tab=readme-ov-file#mixture-models
